assumptions.choice: MACD(12,26,9) is instantiated and its line objects computed, but not referenced in any entry or exit condition.
assumptions.reason: The specification lists MACD as a required indicator but the signal conditions name only ma_crosses and avg_rsi; no MACD threshold or crossover appears in the entry filter or exit rules.

assumptions.choice: size = int(broker.getcash() / bar_close_price) submitted as an explicit size argument to self.buy().
assumptions.reason: The spec states '100% of available capital per trade'; integer share count is derived by dividing full available cash by the close price of the signal bar.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit are evaluated against each bar's close price; when triggered, a market self.close() order is submitted for fill at the next bar's open.
assumptions.reason: The spec does not specify intrabar evaluation. Close-price evaluation is deterministic and avoids ambiguous fill-price assumptions. Market close orders follow the canonical exit default.

assumptions.choice: periods_held resets to 0 when the buy fill is confirmed in notify_order; the first 30-min period-end bar thereafter increments the counter to 1; the close order is issued when the counter reaches 6.
assumptions.reason: '6 30-minute periods following its opening' implies the count starts after entry, not including the entry period itself.

assumptions.choice: To detect a crossover at the first bar of a 30-min window (index -5 from window end), bar index -6 (last bar of the prior window) is used as the 'before' reference.
assumptions.reason: An upward cross at bar N requires bar N-1 to be below; the first bar of a new window must compare to the preceding window's final bar. This bar is always available since next() is not called until SMA(40) (min-period 40) is satisfied, guaranteeing far more than 6 bars of history.

assumptions.choice: Strategy executes on the single provided AAPL feed.
assumptions.reason: The spec calls for 30-50 liquid S&P 500 tickers, but the harness supplies exactly one data feed.

assumptions.choice: Backtest uses the provided ~3-month window (2026-04-15 to 2026-07-10).
assumptions.reason: The spec requests multi-year historical data; only the harness-defined date range is available.
